body.name: Mixed-support atlas handle
body.construction: Construct \(\mathscr A\) by enumerating the labeled support charts formed from oriented rank-two segment modes, the disjoint \(\mathrm L,\mathrm R,\mathrm E,\mathrm D\) rank-one modes with coordinatewise equal-endpoint splits, shared proxy endpoints, and, in design B, projective residual-ratio forest states, active-cycle consistency, positive scales, normalization, and a signed relevance witness. In design A, first test \(m\in\Delta_{\mathcal E}^{\circ}\); failure is incompatibility even when normalized cycle charts are nonempty. Test every applicable chart for emptiness. If all are empty, report incompatibility. Otherwise sample one \(x_0\) in their union, put \(t_0=\tau_C(x_0)\), and on every chart test the one-copy refinement where the squared Euclidean target distance from \(t_0\) is positive. If every refinement is empty, return \(t_0\); otherwise sample one refinement and lift it together with \(x_0\) to legal target-changing full SCMs. Connected-component descriptions are optional diagnostics only. All symbolic arithmetic is over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\), or over the finite real algebraic extension generated by \(t_0\) during the refinement tests.
